{
  "name": "usage-warn",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Warns as the 5-hour and weekly usage windows fill, with a circle per window above the prompt, a pace forecast and a status line",
  "author": {
    "name": "Magnus Pladsen"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "start": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start warning at",
      "description": "The usage percent where warnings and the status line begin",
      "default": "50",
      "options": [
        "30",
        "40",
        "50",
        "60",
        "70",
        "80"
      ]
    },
    "step": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Warn every",
      "description": "Percent between warnings after the start",
      "default": "10",
      "options": [
        "5",
        "10",
        "20"
      ]
    },
    "notifyAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Native notification from",
      "description": "From this percent a warning also raises a macOS notification; off for toasts only",
      "default": "90",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "70",
        "80",
        "90",
        "95"
      ]
    },
    "toastSeconds": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Toast seconds",
      "description": "How long a warning toast stays on screen",
      "default": "8",
      "options": [
        "4",
        "8",
        "15",
        "30"
      ]
    },
    "statusLine": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status line",
      "description": "on: past the start, keep usage, time to reset and the 100% forecast under the prompt",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "indicator": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Usage circles",
      "description": "on: one circle per window in use at the right end of the band above the prompt; hover for details, click to pin them",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "forecast": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pace forecast",
      "description": "on: say when the window hits 100% at the current pace, when that is before the reset",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "sevenDay": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "7-day window",
      "description": "on: warn for the 7-day window too, with the same thresholds",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "sound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound",
      "description": "Play a chime with the native notification, on every warning, or never",
      "default": "with notification",
      "options": [
        "with notification",
        "every step",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
